question: top 5 customers and name of customer with id 201
sql:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

top 5 customers, top 5 products, top 5 marketing chsannels by revenue expenditure

SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id

GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers, top 5 products, top 5 marketing chsannels by revenue expenditure
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 customers, top 5 products, top 5 marketing chsannels by revenue expenditure
sql:
SELECT channel, SUM(amount_spent) AS total_spent
FROM marketing_spend
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month) IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;
